title: Art on Climate 2026 – International Illustration Competition
description: Create illustrations or 10-15 second animated videos on climate change for €12,000 in prizes. Free, open to ages 18+ worldwide.
descriptionDetailed: Organized by Fingertips Company Limited and sponsored by Allianz Global Investors, Art on Climate invites illustrators and video creators to explore the theme of climate change. The Illustration and Animated Video categories offer cash prizes totaling €12,000 across 26 winning works, with up to three submissions per category allowed free of charge.

prize.description: Illustration category: Champion €2,000, 1st runner-up €1,500, 2nd runner-up €1,000, and 20 Merit winners at €150 each. Animated Video category: Champion €2,000, 1st runner-up €1,500, 2nd runner-up €1,000. All winners receive customised e-certificates, and winning works are displayed in a virtual exhibition.

audience.eligibilityLabel: Open to anyone aged 18 or above worldwide
audience.eligibilityDetail: Any person aged 18 or above as of 17 May 2026, from any location, may participate. Employees of the sponsor AllianzGI, the organiser, and their affiliates, plus their household members, are not eligible. Each participant may submit up to 3 illustrations and 3 animated videos.
